A band of pirates calling themselves the "Ransomeers" have kidnapped the crew of a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] private transport vessel.

We intend to free them before the pirates can make any demands.

texts.zh:
一群自称为“星际绑架者”的海盗关押了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]私人运输飞船的船员。

我们想在海盗们提出条件之前就救出他们。
texts.en:
A band of pirates calling themselves the "Ransomeers" have kidnapped the crew of a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] private transport vessel.

We intend to free them before the pirates can make any demands.

label.zh: 舰队进入星际绑架者的系统
label.en: A fleet enters the Ransomeers' system

label.zh: 别人先击毁了绑架者基地（有接触，约50%）
label.en: Someone else destroys the Ransomeer base first (with contact, about 50%)

label.zh: 别人先击毁了绑架者基地（有接触，约50%）
label.en: Someone else destroys the Ransomeer base first (with contact, about 50%)

label.zh: 基地被没有接触的势力击毁
label.en: The base is destroyed by someone you have no contact with
You destroy the Ransomeer base yourself

texts.zh:
虽说海盗的基地十分隐蔽，但若知道如何寻找的话就十分明显了。

一支舰队排着奇怪的队形慢慢从重新运行的采矿设施后慢悠悠飘了出来——显然是并没想到会有不速之客。
texts.en:
The pirate base, while fairly inconspicuous, is obvious when you know what to look for.

A fleet in confused formation slowly drifts out from behind the re-purposed mining complex - they were obviously not expecting company.

label.zh: 打开通讯系统。必须让被囚者做好准备。
label.en: Open comms. The captives need to be ready.

texts.zh:
你好啊，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。看来这一切都是因为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的飞船而起的了？

我们好客的主人们似乎即将离开他们当前的位置。登上这地方对各方都不利，但是……如果你直接对基地发起攻击，我觉得我们倒是可以拼一拼，看看能不能弄到一艘救生艇。

我们出来的时候可别把我们给炸飞了！
texts.en:
Hello again, [Root.GetRulerTitle]. I take it [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships are the cause of all this commotion?

Our hosts seem about ready to leave their posts. Boarding this place would probably end badly for everyone involved, but... If you attack the base directly, I think we can make a break for one of the lifeboats.

Please try not to blow us up on our way out!

label.en: Very well.

title.zh: 星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土

texts.zh: 索取赎金的海盗们的基地被摧毁了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的俘虏们也一道消失了。俘虏们似乎成功联系到了发动进攻的外星飞船，却被对方忽视了。
texts.en: The Ransomeer pirate base has been destroyed, and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] prisoners along with it. It appears the captives managed to hail the alien ships that attacked, but were ignored.

label.zh: 我们绝不会忘记这个悲剧。
label.en: We will never forget this tragedy.
Dust and Echoes

note.zh: 俘虏死亡，对击毁者好感度下降，链结束。
note.en: The captives are dead; opinion of the destroyer drops; the chain ends.

title.zh: 星际绑架者：意外的救星

texts.zh:
[From.From.GetName]的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏在交战中成功逃出，目前已登上一艘救生艇，即将与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]救援飞船接头。
texts.en:
Military action by the [From.From.GetName] has destroyed the Ransomeer forces.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives made a successful escape attempt during the attack, and are now safely on board a lifeboat well on its way to be a rendezvous [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] rescue vessels.

label.en: We are eternally grateful.
Unexpected Saviors

note.zh: 俘虏获救，对击毁者好感度上升，链结束。
note.en: The captives are saved; opinion of the destroyer rises; the chain ends.

texts.zh:
不知何方发起的战斗行动彻底摧毁了星际绑架者的部队。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏们奇迹般地逃出生天，在攻击行动中偷去了一艘救生艇，即将返回[Root.Capital.GetName]。
texts.en:
Military action by an unknown force destroyed the Ransomeer pirates.

Miraculously, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] captives managed to break out and steal a lifeboat during the attack, and are now well on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

label.zh: 真是神秘而偶然的遭遇啊。
label.en: Most fortuitous, and mysterious.
Assailed

note.zh: 无接触的势力击毁基地，链结束。
note.en: A power you have no contact with destroyed the base; the chain ends.

title.en: The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces

texts.zh:
海盗的基地在我方飞船造成的连锁效应中缓慢地分崩离析。与此同时，我们开始了对卢克西昂号生还者的搜索。

如果他们真的上了救生艇，现在也该联络我们了……
texts.en:
As the pirate base slowly tears itself apart in a savage chain reaction instigated by our military vessels, the search for the captive crew of the Luxion begins.

If they made it to a lifeboat, they should be attempting to hail us by now...

label.en: Scan all frequencies.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这里是卢西安号的船员。

计划进行得十分顺利。在你们展开对基地的袭击后，卫兵们都跑上船了，于是我们也成功破坏了囚室大门。救生艇无人看守，看来你们给这群海盗造成了不小的麻烦，完全没人注意到我们逃跑了。
texts.en:
[Root.GetRulerTitle], this is the crew of the Luxion.

The plan went off without a hitch. Once you started bombarding the base directly, the guards took to their ships, and we were able to break down the cell door. The lifeboats were unguarded, and it seems you kept the pirates busy enough that they did not care much about our escape.

label.en: Welcome home, jailbreakers.

texts.zh:
卢克西昂号的船员安全的回到了[Root.Capital.GetName]，一场灾难就此避免，[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]的果断行动让[Root.GetAdj]人民十分自豪。

海盗的绑架勒索事件已经成功划上句点，海盗团也被消灭了，但还有一些事没搞清楚，比如被俘虏的人声称他们在被抓后曾经从飞船窗口中看到了更大型的海盗舰队。从目前情况来看，可以确定威胁比我们实际看到的还要大的多。

进行这次勒索行动的家伙们已经被处理了。
texts.en:
With the crew of the Luxion safely on their way back to [Root.Capital.GetName], disaster has been averted. The [Root.GetAdj] people are sure to glory in the decisive actions of the [Root.GetName]'s [Root.GetRulerTitle].

The situation with the kidnapping Ransomeer pirates, as well as the pirate band itself, has come to an end. Some questions remain, mainly relating to the much larger piratical navy the captives claim to have seen through portholes shortly after their capture. But, considering the circumstances, it can safely be assumed that the threat appeared to be much greater than it actually was.

The Ransomeers are over and done with.

label.en: I wonder...
All's Well?

note.zh: 俘虏获救：较大影响力加成与“救世主”修正（3600天）。
note.en: The captives are saved: a larger influence bonus and the 'savior' modifier (3600 days).

texts.en:
Hel-


-re no lifeboats, we-


-andoned, collapse im-





------------------------

label.en: Captain?

texts.zh:
被关押的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]最终未能逃出海盗基地。我们并未能确认他们到底是如何死亡的——是救生艇未能成功发射，还是他们压根没有逃出囚室——但这不妨碍我们确认他们已死亡的事实。

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]们一定会十分感激[Root.GetName]的[Root.GetRulerTitle]采取的迅速行动，但感觉他们短时间内也不会遗忘这出惨剧。
texts.en:
The kidnapped [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] never made it off the pirate base. We are unable to determine exactly where they met their end - if the lifeboat failed to launch, or if they never made it out of their holding cell - but fact remains that they are dead.

The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people are sure to appreciate the swift actions undertaken by the [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the [Root.GetName], but they are also unlikely to soon forget this tragedy.

label.en: Indeed...
Smoke and Ashes

note.zh: 俘虏死于大火：影响力加成，伴随“失败的救世主”修正（1800天）。
note.en: The captives die in the fire: an influence bonus with the 'failed savior' modifier (1800 days).

summary.text:
# 星际绑架者 / The Ransomeers

- 分类 Category：探索 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2395-2560 (anomaly.3094, chain start; story anomaly-uhb-buoy-cat); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2561 (anomaly.3095); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2592 (anomaly.3096); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2612 (anomaly.3097); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2679-2767 (anomaly.3098-3100); events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2768-2906 (anomaly.3101-3105); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:983 (on_entering_system_fleet); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1577 (on_fleet_destroyed_victim); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1630 (on_fleet_destroyed_perp)

## 如何开始 How it starts

事件链“星际绑架者”由异常 UHB_BUOY_CAT（“多普勒效应”，另一故事 anomaly-uhb-buoy-cat）的 anomaly.3094 开启：设置 captive_rescue 标志，在6跳内选一个无主、无敌对的小行星系统作为“绑架者系统”（标志 ransomeer_system），创建绑架者国家（faction）、绑架者基地与舰队，并在基地处创建兴趣点。

The event chain "The Ransomeers" is started by anomaly.3094 of the anomaly UHB_BUOY_CAT ("Doppler Effect", another story, anomaly-uhb-buoy-cat): it sets captive_rescue, picks an unowned, non-hostile asteroid system within 6 jumps as the Ransomeer system (flag ransomeer_system), creates the Ransomeer faction country, base and fleets, and a point of interest at the base.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

链开启之后有几种进展：
- 舰队进入绑架者系统 → anomaly.3095“星际绑架者：最佳计划”→ anomaly.3096“[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏”（与俘虏通话、说明计划，移除兴趣点；链继续）。
- 自己击毁绑架者基地 → anomaly.3101“星际绑架者：捡拾碎片”：基地国被销毁，随机（各50%）进入 anomaly.3102“已解救[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏”→ anomaly.3105“星际绑架者：一切都好？”（较大的影响力与3600天“救世主”修正），或 anomaly.3103“[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]俘虏”（对话）→ 选项b → anomaly.3104“星际绑架者：化为灰烬”（较小影响力与1800天“失败的救世主”修正）。
- 别人先击毁基地 → 隐藏的 anomaly.3097：与击毁者有接触则 50% anomaly.3098“星际绑架者：尘归尘，土归土”（俘虏死亡，对该国好感下降）/50% anomaly.3099“星际绑架者：意外的救星”（俘虏获救，好感上升）；无接触或击毁者不是普通国家则 anomaly.3100“星际绑架者：质疑”。以上结局都结束事件链。

After the chain starts there are several ways it can go:
- A fleet enters the Ransomeer system → anomaly.3095 "The Ransomeers: Best Laid Plans" → anomaly.3096 "[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives" (talk to the captives and outline the plan, removes the point of interest; the chain continues).
- You destroy the Ransomeer base → anomaly.3101 "The Ransomeers: Picking Up the Pieces": the faction country is destroyed and a random 50/50 leads to anomaly.3102 "Freed [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives" → anomaly.3105 "The Ransomeers: All's Well?" (larger influence and the 3600-day savior modifier) or anomaly.3103 "[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] Captives" (dialogue) → option b → anomaly.3104 "The Ransomeers: Smoke and Ashes" (smaller influence and the 1800-day failed-savior modifier).
- Someone else destroys the base first → hidden anomaly.3097: with contact to the destroyer, 50% anomaly.3098 "The Ransomeers: Dust and Echoes" (captives dead, opinion of that country drops) / 50% anomaly.3099 "The Ransomeers: Unexpected Saviors" (captives saved, opinion rises); without contact or if the destroyer is not an ordinary country, anomaly.3100 "The Ransomeers: Assailed". All these endings end the event chain.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

3101 之后的 3102 / 3103 为 50/50；3097 之后的 3098 / 3099 为 50/50（仅限有接触的普通国家）否则 3100；“进入系统”不是必经步骤，不影响后面的收束。

After 3101, 3102 / 3103 are 50/50; after 3097, 3098 / 3099 are 50/50 (only for an ordinary country you have contact with), otherwise 3100; entering the system is not required and does not affect the endings.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

多个事件的名称含 [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，随俘虏物种变化；3103 的对话选项a只展示回应，选项b结束。

Several event names contain [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] and follow the captives' species; in 3103 dialogue option a only shows a reply and option b ends.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对 anomaly.3094–3105 与三个 on_action 钩子（983 进入、1577 他人击毁、1630 自己击毁）。修正：草稿把“进入系统”“他人击毁”“自己击毁”作为三个互不相连的故事；现合为一个以事件链“星际绑架者”为起点的故事，用审阅连接还原三种进展，并加互斥组。前半段（浮标、SOS、俘虏通话、链开启）属于 c3b 的 anomaly-uhb-buoy-cat。

Checked anomaly.3094-3105 and the three on_action hooks (983 entering, 1577 destroyed by another, 1630 destroyed by you). Correction: the draft treated 'entering the system', 'destroyed by another' and 'destroyed by you' as three unconnected stories; they are now one story starting from the chain "The Ransomeers" with reviewed links restoring the three paths, plus exclusive groups. The first half (buoy, SOS, captive talk, chain start) belongs to c3b's anomaly-uhb-buoy-cat.
